text: {"lessons":["I should not sell winners automatically or buy a stock back at a much higher price without first reassessing its value and my reasons for owning it.","Selling Stock E at a large loss reminds me to set clear criteria for reviewing a falling position instead of letting losses dictate my timing.","When my account keeps falling, doing nothing is still a decision; I should review my holdings and risk regularly while avoiding impulsive trades based on short-term moves."]}
